question: Which of the following dancers is associated with the following two dances - Bharatanatyam and Odissi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonal Mansingh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sonal Mansingh is a renowned Indian classical dancer known for her proficiency in Bharatanatyam and Odissi.
 
• She is one of the prominent cultural personalities in India and has made significant contributions to the field of classical dance.
 
• She has received several prestigious awards, including the Padma Vibhushan and Padma Bhushan, recognizing her outstanding achievements.
 
• In addition to her dance career, Sonal Mansingh is also known for her work in promoting Indian culture and arts globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam**

 
 
• Originated in Tamil Nadu, Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms in India.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork, along with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
• It was traditionally performed by devadasis in temples and has a rich history linked to the cultural traditions of South India.
 
 
 
• **Odissi**
 
 
• Odissi is a classical dance form that originated in the state of Odisha in eastern India.
 
• It is characterized by its fluid movements, grace, and sculpturesque poses that are inspired by the temple sculptures of Odisha.
 
• Odissi performances often depict themes of spirituality and mythology, drawing from ancient Sanskrit texts and regional literature.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards**
 
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors in India, instituted in 1954.
 
• They are awarded in three categories: Padma Vibhushan (for exceptional and distinguished service), Padma Bhushan (for distinguished service of a high order), and Padma Shri (for distinguished service).
 
• The awards recognize achievements in all fields of activities or disciplines where an element of public service is involved.
 
 
 
• **Prominent Indian Classical Dancers**
 
 
• Other than Sonal Mansingh, notable Indian classical dancers include Rukmini Devi Arundale (Bharatanatyam), Kelucharan Mohapatra (Odissi), and Birju Maharaj (Kathak).
 
• These artists have played a pivotal role in the revival and popularization of classical dance forms in India and globally.
